source.post_text:
Gears of War: E-Day early access beta peaked at 14,331 on Steam

Beating Gears 5 all-time max of 10,196 and Gears of War: Reloaded all-time max of 4,819

*This is only the early access, which has limited access. We should see bigger numbers for the beta on Aug 13-17
